title: Hollowing
description: A simple plugin that can control spread plant(bamboo) grow
body:
## Description​​
Precisely controls bamboo diffusion growth behavior and manages bamboo hollowing operations.
no dependencies​​

## Features​
### Usage
- Players can use shears on bamboo to hollowing.
- Removes growth restrictions when marked bamboo is broken.
  
### Data Persistence​​
- Automatically saves hollowing locations to bamboo.yml,simple to manage
- Supports hot-reloading configurations without server restart
- All data is stored in YAML files for simple and convenient management.
